credit_limit.definition: The most the bank will let you borrow on the card at one time. Going over it is usually refused and sometimes charged.
credit_limit.example: My credit limit is 2000 $, and I use about 600 $ of it.

er_window_of_tolerance.definition: The range of feeling intensity in which a person can hold the feeling and still think and speak plainly.
er_window_of_tolerance.example: Outside his window of tolerance, every comment sounded like an accusation.

gem_overlap.definition: The part of the value ranges of two groups that lies on top of each other.
gem_overlap.example: The overlap between the two groups is wide, so the average says very little about one person.

gre_hegemonic_masculinity.definition: The pattern in which one form of manliness becomes the standard everybody is measured against.
gre_hegemonic_masculinity.example: Hegemonic masculinity sets the picture of the man who never complains, and the man who does is treated as a smaller version of it.

mon_quote_currency.definition: The currency of the pair that the rate is expressed in, so the rate says how many units of it you get.
mon_quote_currency.example: The rate is given in the quote currency, so a pair written EUR/USD reads in dollars.

mt_median_age.definition: The age in the middle of a list: half the group is older and half is younger.
mt_median_age.example: The median age stayed where the middle of the group was, even as the mean age rose.
